comment_purpose: The systems Claude works with, as data: each one's role, what hands work to it and what it hands on, its free or included limit with the source page, the quote and the date it was read, and how its live usage is read. The Process page's Systems tab is drawn from this file, and tools/collect_org.mjs reads the usage it names. Roles come from rules/compute.md and the site repo's ops/ci/models-and-tools.md; every limit was re-read on its own page on 2026-11-03.
comment_usage: usage.metric is the data/org.json id that rates use against limits[0]; usage.how says how it is read, usage.why why it is not. reads lists what tools/systems.mjs reads into data/org.json, each by a reader kind: rate_limit (GitHub, free to call), quality_metric (an entry of the Quality data the collector fetched), guard_notice (a Blacksmith minute guard's CI notice), comfy_status (comfy cloud status, read-only) or app_sessions (an app's session folder on this Mac account). at places a system on the map as [column, row]; lanes give each lane's first row. A goal has a measure (under_goal: the share of measured systems under usage_goal; past_limit: how many are past their limit) or a metric. models lays out the Models lane: a cell is a metric, a metric's complement (100 less it), a sum of metrics, or a why.
